adjudication.query:
WITH current_runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, engine, gpu, tp, window_name, superseded_by
  FROM provenance.v_dim
  WHERE is_current = true
), startup AS (
  SELECT d.run_id, d.engine, d.gpu, d.tp, d.window_name, d.superseded_by,
         s.span_name, s.duration_ms / 1000.0 AS duration_s
  FROM current_runs d
  JOIN provenance.vllm_otlp_startup s USING (run_id)
), per_window AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(window_name, '<none>') AS window_name,
         COUNT(DISTINCT run_id) AS runs,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_name = 'Overall Loading') AS overall_observations,
         MIN(duration_s) FILTER (WHERE span_name = 'Overall Loading') AS min_overall_s,
         MAX(duration_s) FILTER (WHERE span_name = 'Overall Loading') AS max_overall_s
  FROM startup
  GROUP BY COALESCE(window_name, '<none>')
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT run_id) AS current_run_denominator,
  COUNT(*) AS current_span_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT run_id) FILTER (WHERE superseded_by IS NOT NULL) AS superseded_current_runs,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_name = 'Overall Loading') AS overall_observations,
  MIN(duration_s) FILTER (WHERE span_name = 'Overall Loading') AS min_overall_s,
  MAX(duration_s) FILTER (WHERE span_name = 'Overall Loading') AS max_overall_s,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_name = 'Overall Loading' AND duration_s >= 60) AS minute_scale_observations,
  MAX(duration_s) FILTER (WHERE span_name = 'Load weights') AS load_weights_s,
  MAX(duration_s) FILTER (WHERE span_name = 'Warmup (GPU)') AS warmup_gpu_s,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_name ILIKE '%schedul%') AS scheduling_observations,
  (SELECT json_agg(per_window ORDER BY window_name) FROM per_window) AS per_window_breakdown
FROM startup
